shellCommands.command:
grep -rn "updateTag\|revalidateTag\|cacheTag\|cacheLife\|expireTag" node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/unstable-cache.js node_modules/next/types 2>/dev/null | head -50
echo "---searching cache.d.ts---"
find node_modules/next -iname "*cache*" -name "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -ln "updateTag\|revalidateTag\|expireTag" 2>/dev/null

grep -rn "function updateTag\|function revalidateTag\|function refresh" node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.js
echo "---"
sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.js

cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'
echo "---config schema search---"
grep -rn "cacheComponents\|useCache\b" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30
echo "---dynamicIO---"
grep -rn "dynamicIO" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -10

find node_modules/next/dist/server/after -maxdepth 1
echo "---"
cat node_modules/next/dist/server/after/after.d.ts 2>/dev/null
echo "---impl---"
sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/next/dist/server/after/after.js 2>/dev/null
(npx next dev -p 3117 > /tmp/next-dev.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -s http://localhost:3117/ | grep -oE '\$[0-9]+'

cd /workspace
FORM_HTML=$(curl -s http://localhost:3117/)
ACTION_ID=$(echo "$FORM_HTML" | grep -oE '"id":"[a-f0-9]+"' | head -1 | grep -oE '[a-f0-9]{20,}')
echo "action id guess: $ACTION_ID"
echo "$FORM_HTML" | grep -oE '<form[^>]*>' 
echo "---looking for action hidden field / next-action header pattern---"
echo "$FORM_HTML" | grep -oE 'action="[^"]*"'

cd /workspace time curl -s -o /tmp/sync-response.html -w "http_code=%{http_code}\n" \ -X POST http://localhost:3117/ \ -F '$ACTION_ID_001b2b343ec879f2c26b651455f11449c24d793a3e=' echo "---response snippet---" tr -d '\n' < /tmp/sync-response.html | grep -oE '.*
'

sleep 3 curl -s http://localhost:3117/ | tr -d '\n' | grep -oE '.*
' echo "---dev log tail---" tail -30 /tmp/next-dev.log
